answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the anchor queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The willow index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 327 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mirror. Collateral of 51 dollars is at risk. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
